story.title: The Quiet Proposal
pages: At the town meeting, Noor proposed turning an unused parking lot into a garden. Her diagram included accessible paths, but the shopkeepers worried about losing delivery space.
Instead of treating their objection as a rejection, Noor visited the shops and mapped when deliveries arrived. She revised the plan to reserve a loading lane before noon.
The council approved a one-season trial. Noor understood that a useful compromise had strengthened her proposal rather than diminished it.
